annotations.title: Pre-check an Upper C-band clearinghouse claim

description: Validate one FCC Upper C-band claim before it is filed, against the records the Clearinghouse pays from: a lump sum election (kind=lumpsum: claimant_name, call_sign, site_id, antennas as 'ID=qty|ID=qty', antenna_type single|multi|smb|lmb|gateway|tfe, mvpd_site) checked against the Oct 15 2026 incumbent list (DA 26-1126), the 2020 and 2025 lists, licensee FRNs, Form 323 control groups, dish co-location across call signs and OFAC / foreign-adversary flags; or a radio altimeter rebate (kind=altimeter: claimant_name, n_number, radio_altimeters, retrofit_type upgrade|replacement, trustee_certification, optional serial) checked against the FAA Aircraft Registry (owner of record, trustee, registration status and expiry, airframe serial, ownership changes since FCC 26-46, co-owners). Returns pass / warn / fail per rule with the reason and the record compared, the verdict (accepted / review / rejected) and the amount at the preliminary DA 26-1049 / proposed DA 26-1076 figures. Nothing is recorded. Free.
name: clearinghouse_precheck
